System: Finance-AdminIdentity
Assessment focus: IA-2 (Identification and Authentication)

A production global-administrator account is shared by the on-call team and uses a password without MFA. The administration endpoint is restricted to the private operations network and VPN authentication is separately required. No log entry shows use by an unauthorized person, but actions performed with the shared account cannot be reliably tied to one administrator.
